summary: Bluerock Homes Trust, Inc. filed an 8-K reporting a material definitive agreement and creation of a financial obligation. Through a subsidiary, it provided a $33.088 million secured loan to an affiliate to fund part of a DST's acquisition of an office/lab facility via sale-leaseback, financed with a senior credit facility. The loan carries a 13% coupon, 36-month term, secured by Class II interests. The company also provided a non-recourse carveout guaranty. This is a routine financing arrangement, not a special situation.
